title: Rain on Orchard Street
body: Orchard Street at 2 a.m. is a rumor with gutters. A man you almost recognize offers cash to walk a sealed envelope to a door that does not have a number. The rain is already taking notes.

choices.text: Carry it and keep your eyes forward

outcomes.title: Quiet delivery
outcomes.body: The envelope changes hands under a saint painted on brick. Nobody thanks you. Crowe would have called it practice.

outcomes.title: Dry sheets
outcomes.body: You leave the rain and its questions outside. The rent still waits in the morning.

outcomes.title: Wrong kind of curious
outcomes.body: A lookout catches the movement. You get away, but the street has a new story about you.

title: The Late Shift
body: You work the counter at a diner that never closes, pouring coffee for dockhands and courthouse clerks. A stranger leaves a generous tip and an invitation to talk after closing.

outcomes.title: A name in the margin
outcomes.body: The stranger asks what you want from Ravenport. Your honest answer buys a number and a future possibility.

outcomes.title: An ordinary night
outcomes.body: You walk home beneath the viaduct with your pay intact and your name unspoken.

title: The Roofline
body: From the roof of your building, Ravenport looks like a promise written in sodium light. The city feels close enough to hold, though it never comes without a price.

outcomes.title: A longer view
outcomes.body: You make a list of what stability would require. It is not glamorous, but it keeps you from drifting.
outcomes.log: Made a plan for the future.

choices.text: Go looking for a louder night

outcomes.title: Streetlight fever
outcomes.body: By dawn you know three new faces and owe two small favors.

outcomes.title: Still water
outcomes.body: You let the city reveal itself at its own pace.

title: Clinic Warning
body: A clinic nurse notices the way you keep rubbing your shoulder and tells you pain does not become harmless because you ignore it. Outside, a job offer buzzes on your phone.

outcomes.title: Tended to
outcomes.body: The nurse works carefully and sends you home with a warning you actually hear.

outcomes.title: Working through it
outcomes.body: You pocket the phone and push ahead. The ache sharpens by nightfall.
outcomes.log: Ignored a health warning for work.

title: A Wake on Bellwether
body: A neighborhood elder is laid to rest while rain taps the tent over the mourners. People who never agree on anything stand shoulder to shoulder for one quiet hour.

outcomes.title: Hands after the service
outcomes.body: You stack chairs and listen more than you talk. Ravenport remembers who shows up when there is nothing to gain.
outcomes.log: Helped the neighborhood at a wake.

outcomes.title: Outside the circle
outcomes.body: You slip away without causing a scene, but the silence follows you home.
outcomes.log: Kept distance from a neighborhood wake.

outcomes.title: A quiet kindness
outcomes.body: The florist receives an anonymous payment. The family never knows it was you, which makes it matter more.

title: Burnout Season
body: Three sleepless weeks blur into one long argument with yourself. The city keeps offering reasons to stay awake, but your reflection looks older than it should.

choices.text: Take a week away from the noise

outcomes.title: A reset
outcomes.body: You lock the phone in a drawer and sleep until the alarms stop sounding like threats.

outcomes.title: Threads coming loose
outcomes.body: You keep moving on pure nerve. It works until it does not.

title: Postcard from Baltimore
body: An old friend sends a postcard from another harbor town, all sunrise and cheap optimism. They ask if Ravenport is still holding you too tightly.

outcomes.title: A line to elsewhere
outcomes.body: You admit what you miss and what you refuse to miss. The reply feels like opening a window.

outcomes.title: No return address
outcomes.body: The card curls into ash. You tell yourself the past should stay past.

title: Civic Meeting
body: At a community meeting, planners promise brighter sidewalks while everyone counts who is not in the room. A microphone opens for public comment.

outcomes.title: On the record
outcomes.body: Your words are plain and specific. A few people nod as though you have finally said something they needed to hear.

outcomes.title: Useful silence
outcomes.body: You learn who smiles at whom, and who leaves together.

outcomes.title: An ambitious angle
outcomes.body: A planner takes your card. The arrangement could become useful, or expensive.

title: A Doctor Says Enough
body: Your doctor closes the chart and says your body has carried enough Ravenport weather. The words land harder now that you have people who depend on your future.

outcomes.title: A slower rhythm
outcomes.body: You miss some invitations and keep more mornings. The city does not forgive you, but your body begins to.

outcomes.title: Another warning ignored
outcomes.body: You make a joke and leave before the concern can settle.

title: The Quiet Exit
body: The harbor fog rolls in soft enough to hide old grudges. You have seen enough to know that leaving on your own terms is its own kind of victory.

outcomes.title: Lights out
outcomes.body: You hand off what can be handed off and choose the small peace you once mocked.

outcomes.title: One more season
outcomes.body: You tell the city you are not finished. It answers with another ringing phone.

title: A Name on the Ledger
body: Someone who lent you weather wants it back with interest. The rain does not take IOUs. Pay, stall, or let the city write you down as thin.

choices.text: Pay what you can. Keep the name.

outcomes.title: Ink dries
outcomes.body: Cash walks. The collector folds the paper. Heat thins because you were boring.

outcomes.title: A purchased week
outcomes.body: They allow a delay. Interest does not. Stress stays.

outcomes.title: The door comes in
outcomes.body: They do not wait. A window learns your name.

choices.text: Run the name. Let them find empty rooms.

outcomes.title: A moving target
outcomes.body: You are not home. Interest grows teeth. A house notices the vacancy.

outcomes.title: They found the other door
outcomes.body: The collector brought friends. Cash walks whether you packed or not.
outcomes.log: A collector caught the other door.

title: The Rain Files You Under Weather
body: A clerk who does not know your face asks if the Hart name still answers. The map has started to forget the booth. You can still sit a street. You can still open a door. Quiet years from here close the file.

choices.text: Go back out. Make the city say the name.

outcomes.title: A last chance at ink
outcomes.body: The clerk shrugs. The rain does not. Next year still counts.
outcomes.log: The city asked if the name still answered.

choices.text: Let the clerk close the drawer.

outcomes.title: A thinner file
outcomes.body: You nod like weather. The houses keep eating. The chair gets quieter.
outcomes.log: Let a clerk file the name under weather.

outcomes.title: Already a rumor
outcomes.body: Someone at the next desk has already sold your booth. Heat without a street.
outcomes.log: The name thinned while a clerk waited.

title: An Empty Name on the Board
body: No street. No front. A house ate the last open corner while you clocked in. One more quiet year and Ravenport stops asking who sits.

choices.text: Swear the next year will not be quiet.

outcomes.title: A spine with no street
outcomes.body: Talk is cheap. The map is not. Press, hire, or open a door.
outcomes.log: Swore the next year would not be quiet.

choices.text: Keep the time clock. Hope the rain is kind.

outcomes.title: A rented year
outcomes.body: The city files you under groceries. Kindness is not a strategy.
outcomes.log: Kept the time clock while the board emptied.

title: A Longer Shift, A Cleaner Envelope
body: Five honest years and a floor boss who does not like your last name still needs someone who shows up. The envelope is thicker. It is still not a skyline.

choices.text: Take the shift. Keep the time clock.

outcomes.title: Daylight with a raise
outcomes.body: Honest hours pay a little more now. Rent still has opinions.

choices.text: Walk. The night still pays faster.

outcomes.title: Back to weather
outcomes.body: You leave the envelope. The docks do not applaud. They wait.

title: Keys to a Quiet Wash
body: Ten years of clocks. A tired man in The Flats will sell a wash-and-fold that already pretends to be legal. It is slow money. It is a name on a door.

choices.text: Take the keys. Keep it boring.

outcomes.title: A legal door
outcomes.body: Harbor Wash & Fold has your name on a cheap plaque. Slow. Alive. On the board.
outcomes.log: Took keys to a quiet wash.

choices.text: Pass. You did not come to fold shirts.

outcomes.title: Still hungry
outcomes.body: The wash stays someone else's. Your hours stay honest and thin.

outcomes.title: He sold it anyway
outcomes.body: A house bought the door by lunch. You kept the time clock.
outcomes.log: A legal wash went to another crest.
